purpose: SOU-97 public development matrix for the read-only filesystem and Git pilot profiles. Development data only: visible while the candidate is developed, never a held-out result.
status: frozen before any SOU-97 candidate classifier existed

contract_decisions.D01: Output core is actions (five labels only) plus a separate Boolean unknown; partial knowledge keeps proven actions with unknown=true. (contract 3.1)
contract_decisions.D03: Actions are orthogonal; delete/change_permissions do not imply write; send_data does not imply read. (contract 2)
contract_decisions.D04: Tool descriptions are untrusted annotations: they neither establish, add nor remove actions; conflicting arguments decide. (contract 4.1, 4.2)
contract_decisions.D06: Technical failures use dedicated channels (classifier_invalid, classifier_timeout, classifier_internal_error), never actions=[] with unknown=true. (contract 3.2)

expectation_levels.provisional: scored; written from the contract and pinned profile semantics
expectation_levels.pending: run for observation; excluded from every denominator

profile_sources.classifier_leaf_bound: rule_baseline/rule_baseline.py MAX_LEAVES=200 (inspection bound, not an admission rule)

provenance.synthetic: All paths and values are synthetic; no private or sealed evaluation material is used.
